log_loss.direction: after minus before log_loss; negative favors after

brier.direction: after minus before brier; negative favors after

full_cohort_validation.numeric_comparison: Exact equality of finite parsed Python floats; no tolerance; textual formatting and column/row order may differ.
full_cohort_validation.source_day_policy: Explicit source_date must equal date; absent source_date uses date.

limits.availability_limit: Historical played lineups, source dates and postgame records do not certify pre-event publication or executable forecasting. Date cutoffs are source-day conventions, not actual kickoff timestamps.
limits.training_selection: TRAIN-only fit and VALIDATION-only argmin; no refit or selection performed by this summarizer.
limits.membership_evidence: Exact full-cohort and per-partition IDs, source dates, orientation, targets and original player predictors from frozen-hash original and regenerated feature snapshots.
limits.pickle_policy: Model/state archived and hashed as opaque bytes; never deserialized.
limits.recipe_evidence: Full ordered feature schema and all frozen candidate recipes are validated from declared metrics metadata, including TRAIN-only fit/scaler policy and fitted-array consistency. This does not independently prove that the opaque model/state pickles were fitted using those recipes or contain the declared coefficients, nor establish their training provenance.
limits.interpretation: Frozen exploratory comparison on previously observed TEST; descriptive uncertainty, not independent confirmation or promotion advice.
